results.name: City Infrastructure Base Map
results.description:
A comprehensive, low-poly city road network perfect for urban environments, city-building games, or driving simulations.

This layout features a realistic flow of infrastructure, including standard multi-lane city streets, smooth curves, and various intersection types (crossroads and T-junctions). A key feature of this model is the elevated highway/overpass section supported by concrete pillars, adding verticality and complexity to the terrain.

Key Features:

    Multi-lane road segments with painted lane markings.

    Elevated highway bridges with structural support pillars.

    Multiple intersection nodes for complex traffic routing.

    Clean, low-poly geometry optimized for real-time rendering and game engines.

    Flat terrain base, ready to be populated with buildings and props.

results.name: Basement Parking Garage Environment Underground

results.name: Modern_ House_ Construction
results.description:
**Hello fellow architecture and 3D enthusiasts!** I'm thrilled to unveil my latest addition to the Sketchfab portfolio: an impressive two-story house under construction that demands your attention. 🏗️

Building upon the success of my previous house model months ago [link](http://sketchfab.com/3d-models/brick-house-construction-site-f1f6224fd30e48d18207e1135414a35a), I've taken photogrammetry to new heights with this creation. I've meticulously captured every intricate detail, resulting in a stunning model comprised of 2.7 million faces.

**Step into this virtual realm and prepare to be captivated by the sheer intricacy of the design**. From the ornate pillars to the windows frames, the craftsmanship on display is nothing short of extraordinary

You can freely download this model and utilize it in your own projects. Whether you're an architect seeking inspiration or a 3D artist looking to enhance your portfolio, this house provides a versatile asset that can elevate your creative endeavors. 🌇
